title: A client itinerary for a travel agent
description: Assemble the confirmations and the trip plan, hand them to the client and discuss changes next to the booking they concern.

blocks.text: A travel agent assembles confirmations for a client and then answers questions about the trip. One handsome file goes stale after the first booking is replaced.

quote.text: I can’t (or don’t want to) remember what documents were like before I invested in Travefy! The system is simple and powerful.

blocks.text: Confirmations are linked to parts of the itinerary. Incomplete entries are visible before the handover; after a correction the client gets a clear new version and can open the original document.
What decides whether it is useful

The first version is worth testing on one real trip that changes. If the work stops at a good-looking PDF, the advantage over an existing template will be small. What matters more is convenient support of an itinerary already handed over.
